question: Tell me about Adhiparasakthi Engineering College (APEC).
variations: Tell me about Adhiparasakthi Engineering College (APEC).
answer: Adhiparasakthi Engineering College (APEC) was established in 1984. It is an NAAC Accredited Institution, UGC Autonomous College, Affiliated to Anna University, ISO 9001:2015 Certified. It is managed by Adhiparasakthi Charitable, Medical, Educational and Cultural Trust (ACMEC Trust), Melmaruvathur (Estd. 1978).

question: What are the admission process, application fee and cutoff details at APEC?
variations: What are the admission process, application fee and cutoff details at APEC?
What is the application fee and cutoff formula?
answer: Admission details: Application cost is Rs. 700/- applicable for both UG & PG registration paths. Selection basis: Consortium Entrance Examination results paired with Anna University single window allocations. Original certificates and two authenticated Xerox copies must be handed in during induction.. Cutoff formula: Cutoff = Mathematics Marks (Out of 100) + [Physics Marks (Out of 100) / 2] + [Chemistry Marks (Out of 100) / 2]. FEES ONCE PAID WILL NOT BE REFUNDED either in full or partially under any circumstances.
